claims.summary: In Portuguese, the position of certain adjectives can change the meaning or nuance of an expression. Preceding the noun often conveys a descriptive sense, while following it can introduce evaluative or figurative meaning.
The article explains that adjectives placed after a noun tend to maintain a descriptive sense, while those placed before can take on evaluative or figurative meanings.
The article provides examples demonstrating how adjective placement affects meaning, such as 'Ele foi um grande professor' vs 'Vi um homem grande na porta'.
